screening_decisions.reason: RCT in patients with frozen shoulder; compares mobilisation (manual therapy) versus intraarticular steroids, ice therapy, and no treatment. Meets population, intervention, and comparison criteria.
Observational study on shoulder disorders in general practice; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
Educational/narrative article; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
Open RCT in patients with frozen shoulder; compares physical therapy (exercise + modalities) plus arthrographic distension versus physical therapy alone. Includes an exercise intervention.
Methodological review of trial reporting; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
RCT in patients with idiopathic adhesive capsulitis; intervention includes deep friction massage (manual therapy) and capsular stretching (exercise). Meets all criteria.
RCT in patients with frozen shoulder; compares two different exercise programs (glenohumeral ROM vs. additional scapulothoracic exercises). Meets criteria for exercise intervention and comparison.
Randomized multiple-treatment trial in frozen shoulder; compares three mobilization techniques (manual therapy). Meets all criteria.

Likely RCT or quasi-randomised trial in chronic peri-arthritis (frozen shoulder population); compares PNF exercises versus conventional exercises. Exercise intervention is relevant. Included conservatively.
RCT in patients with adhesive capsulitis; compares two different glide mobilization directions (manual therapy). Meets population, intervention, and comparison criteria.
Cross-sectional prevalence study; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
Case report; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
Placebo-controlled RCT in adhesive capsulitis; supervised physiotherapy arm includes manual therapy and/or exercise. Meets all criteria.
RCT in adhesive capsulitis; after joint distension, compares manual therapy and directed exercise (physiotherapy) versus sham ultrasound. Includes manual therapy/exercise intervention.
Questionnaire validation study; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
Non-randomised comparative study (no mention of random allocation). Does not meet trial design criteria.
Systematic review; not a primary RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
RCT in adhesive capsulitis; compares two mobilization techniques (manual therapy). Meets all criteria.
Methodological study on outcome reporting bias; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
Abstract describes a study on multiple sclerosis, not frozen shoulder; not an RCT on adhesive capsulitis. Mismatched abstract.
RCT in frozen shoulder; compares physiotherapy (likely exercise/manual therapy) versus injection and combination. Meets criteria.
RCT in adhesive capsulitis; compares Cyriax approach (deep friction massage + mobilisation exercises) vs physical therapy (both include exercise). Manual therapy/exercise interventions are present.
Prospective natural history study; no intervention comparison, not an RCT.
Methodological paper; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
Book chapter; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
Observational prospective study; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
RCT in adhesive capsulitis; compares mobilization + active exercises vs active exercises alone. Manual therapy intervention meets criteria.
RCT in adhesive capsulitis; physical therapy arm likely includes exercise, which qualifies as an exercise intervention. Meets criteria.
EMG study during exercises; not an RCT evaluating treatment outcomes.
Study on chronic shoulder pain (mixed diagnoses, not specifically adhesive capsulitis); population does not meet criteria.
RCT in adhesive capsulitis; physiotherapy group includes exercise intervention. Meets criteria.
Book chapter; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
Retrospective study; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
RCT in adhesive capsulitis; compares two mobilization techniques (manual therapy). Meets all criteria.
Book chapter; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
Observational study; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
RCT in shoulder periarthritis, but interventions are electrotherapy modalities (iontophoresis/phonophoresis), not manual therapy or exercise. Not relevant to the review.
RCT in painful stiff shoulder (periarthritis, equivalent to adhesive capsulitis); physiotherapy arm includes exercise/manual therapy. Meets criteria.

RCT in frozen shoulder; both intervention groups received shoulder exercises (exercise intervention) combined with electrotherapy, compared to no treatment. Exercise is a relevant component. Meets criteria.
RCT in adhesive capsulitis; comparing physical therapy (likely exercise/manual therapy) plus ibuprofen vs ibuprofen alone. Manual therapy/exercise is the intervention.
RCT in adhesive capsulitis; compares end range mobilization + exercises/ultrasound vs exercises/ultrasound alone. Manual therapy intervention is present.
RCT in adhesive capsulitis; compares two glide mobilization directions (manual therapy). Meets all criteria.
RCT in shoulder capsulitis (adhesive capsulitis); physiotherapy arm includes manual therapy and exercise. Meets criteria.

RCT in adhesive capsulitis; compares manipulation under anaesthesia (manual therapy), peri-articular injection, and physiotherapy (exercise/manual therapy). Includes manual therapy/exercise interventions.
Systematic review; not a primary RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
Book chapter; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
RCT in adhesive capsulitis (limited glenohumeral mobility); compares joint mobilization (manual therapy) and self-exercises (exercise). Meets criteria.

Prospective, systematically allocated clinical trial (likely quasi-randomised) in adhesive capsulitis; compares two manual therapy approaches (manipulation vs. mobilization) combined with exercise. Meets criteria for manual therapy/exercise intervention.
RCT in adhesive capsulitis; compares two intensities of mobilization (manual therapy). Meets all criteria.
Pilot RCT in adhesive capsulitis; compares home exercises plus passive mobilisation (manual therapy) vs home exercises alone. Includes manual therapy and exercise interventions.
